name: Queen Pirate: Love Adrift
source:
For anyone else, setting sail for a betrothal would be a dangerous proposition—but the Crystal Eye in your possession, your bejeweled birthright, makes you unsinkable. But on the eve of your betrothal, a treacherous plot unfolds. Suddenly you're surrounded by three debonair pirates eager to steal your booty.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.pirateotome]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
对旁人而言，扬帆出海前去订婚可是个危险的主意。但你拥有与生俱来的宝物“水晶之眼”，有这件珠宝在身，你的船便不会沉没。谁料订婚前夕，一场卑劣的阴谋展开了。转眼间，三位风度翩翩的海盗将你团团围住，一心想抢走你的宝贝。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.pirateotome]Google Play[/url]］
